tasks.brief: Create src/services/llm.py: Define FALLBACK_REPLY = 'The language model is currently unavailable. Please try again in a moment.' Define stream_reply(message: str) -> Iterator[tuple] that yields ("token", str) for each non-empty upstream content increment, ("done") after clean completion with >=1 token, or ("error") on any failure. Inside stream_reply, read LLM_ENDPOINT, LLM_MODEL, LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT, LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from os.environ at call time. Build a streaming httpx.Client().post() to LLM_ENDPOINT with stream=True. Parse SSE lines: iterate response.iter_lines(), match 'data: <json>' lines, extract choices[0].delta.content when non-empty and yield ("token", content). On 'data: [DONE]' line, if tokens were already yielded yield ("done"), else yield ("error"). On connection error, timeout, non-2xx, malformed JSON, or EOF without [DONE], yield ("error"). Wrap the httpx stream call in 'with client.stream(...) as response:'. Do NOT export generate_reply. Only export stream_reply and FALLBACK_REPLY. Use typing.Iterator. Acceptance: stream_reply('hi') with mocked upstream yielding ['{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hel"}}]}', '[DONE]'] produces [("token", "Hel"), ("done",)]. With connection error yields [("error",)]. With [DONE] only yields [("error",)]. With non-2xx yields [("error",)]. Config read at call time (re-import not needed).
tasks.smoke_check: python3 -c "from src.services.llm import stream_reply, FALLBACK_REPLY; assert callable(stream_reply); assert isinstance(FALLBACK_REPLY, str); import inspect; assert 'yield' in inspect.getsource(stream_reply)"
python3 -c "from src.api.chat import router; assert router is not None"

tasks.brief: Modify src/static/index.html: Replace fetch/render logic to handle streaming SSE responses. On form submit, call fetch POST /api/v1/chat with {"message": <text>}. Read response.body as a stream and parse SSE frames. For event: token, extract content from data JSON and append to chat display live. For event: done, finalize the stream (no more content expected). For event: error, append FALLBACK_REPLY text to chat display. Handle connection errors gracefully (show fallback). Acceptance: Page loads with GET / serving index.html; form submit triggers streaming fetch; token events append content live; done event finalizes; error event shows fallback text.
tasks.smoke_check: python3 -c "import os; assert os.path.exists('src/static/index.html'); content = open('src/static/index.html').read(); assert 'fetch' in content and '/api/v1/chat' in content"
